mentions.anchor: At least one stays on. The camera only asks for the ones switched on.

Video and images of your face are never sent.
- **Facial expressions are off by default.** If you turn them on, the SDK estimates them on this computer. The language model then gets the current label (for example "neutral") and how often each label showed recently, never the video.
